input_files: Current PubMed-linked references already curated in site content
generated_from.review_note: Batch-first consolidation of enrichment Waves 1-50. Findings preserve null/mixed outcomes, study certainty, population boundaries, exact botanical/compound identity, formulation boundaries, retraction handling, and safety/interaction context. Repository-wide validation intentionally deferred until after consolidation.

policy.evidence_merge: append-only; one canonical last-revision row per record_id; sources deduplicated by stable source_id/PMID
policy.claim_calibration: retain negative/null evidence, uncertainty, GRADE/quality constraints, endpoint discordance, species/formulation/population limits, and safety context; never convert studied exposures into universal consumer dosing
policy.verification_strategy: batch-first; full repository tests and CI run once after Waves 1-50 consolidation
